task: Add a `codemie proxy reset-mcp-auth --claude-desktop` command that removes the `custom3pMcpOAuth` key from Claude Desktop's Claude-3p `config.json` on Linux, macOS and Windows, preserving all other settings and never printing or logging token values.

key_reasoning.reason: Closest pattern is removeDesktopConfig (connectors/desktop.ts) behind `proxy disconnect --claude-desktop`: resolve getClaudeDesktopBaseDir, read JSON, strip keys, keep unrelated keys, ConfigurationError 'file was not changed', restart notice. It covers structure and error handling but not the new aspect: this is the first CodeMie code to modify a Desktop-owned, credential-bearing file outside configLibrary/ (<Claude-3p>/config.json). Secret handling is a divergence, so the base M is bumped to L. Open items: the effect of deleting custom3pMcpOAuth is unverified Desktop behaviour, macOS and Windows file layouts are unobserved, no Desktop-running detection exists, and a running Desktop may rewrite the file. Parse-error messages must not echo file content. Nearest calibration example (bundled EPMCDME-10203, M, total 15) agrees on band; its technical risk is S because it follows an established endpoint pattern with no secret-bearing data, which is the difference here.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from M to L: credential-bearing Desktop-owned file with no existing secret-handling precedent in the closest pattern (auto-bump for security-sensitive divergence; the 'never print or log tokens' requirement is the same signal, counted once)
